title: Page 4
content_zh:
众人顿时全没了声响，五十几双眼睛纷纷看向门口。

一名西装笔挺的高大男人踏进会议室，俊秀脸上戴着一副无框眼镜，更显得斯文内敛，踩着自信的步伐站到台前，视线缓缓扫视在场所有人。

他身边跟着一名保镳和两名秘书，当他坐下时，三人毕恭毕敬地站在他身后。

「大家好，我是Chris。」

Chris的视线扫到蒋婷悦时，蒋婷悦朝他露出甜美的微笑，他只略微点点头，又继续往下扫视。

但这一眼给了大家无限想像—蒋婷悦果然认识新老板。

Chris一路往下看，视线落到如斯脸上时，神情微微一愣，显得有些困惑，又像在思索什么，两秒钟后，他的目光才接着往下移动。

如斯没错过他眼中的迟疑。

新老板为什么那样看她？她看着Chris，一股难以言喻的熟悉感如潮水般一波波涌向她。

他是谁？

Chris先说了一段稳定军心的话，要大家好好工作，另外祭出令人垂涎的奖金制度，不管是谁，只要卖出公司经手的艺术品，一律另外抽成百分之五，包括画廊的所有伙伴。

接着重头戏来了，Chris开始一一询问各部门主管工作概况。

表面上看来，他是认真听着各主管的报告内容，但其实他对于公司运作早就了然于胸，之所以问，只是想掂掂每个人的能力和分量。

蒋婷悦虽然不久前才进公司，但报告起来条理分明又流畅，最后她还加码提议每半年对所有总公司员工进行评分，得分落在最后三分之一的人必须离职，让公司能持续不断地去芜存菁，留下优秀的员工。

这些话一出口，所有人当场呆住，现场气氛顿时尴尬到极点，众人面面相觑，没有人有所回应。

Chris也只是淡淡笑着，没说话，故意让场面僵着。

过了一会儿，小慧第一个跳出来说道：「我反对，这是变相的每年裁员。」

阿杰立刻声援，「我也反对，这样做会让同事变成竞争对手。」

「就某种程度而言，同事是最好的竞争对手。」蒋婷悦面无表情的说道，「不只员工会被淘汰，老板也会被淘汰，像这间公司的前老板就是。」

此话一出，现场气氛又更冷凝了。

「前老板是因为前阵子淹大水，把蒋婷悦冷冷的瞪了一眼后，接下来的话自动消音。

Chris对这项提议不置可否，笑笑的请下一个主管报告。

Chris的反应让蒋婷悦有些不悦的沉下脸。

她不是第一天出社会工作，很清楚自己提出这项议题有多惹人厌，但为了讨好Chris，获得他的认同，同时表示自己对他全心全意的支持，她这么做了。

她想得到的不只是一名优秀员工这样的身分，她希望能够永远站在他身边。

大学时代，她因为年轻爱玩，错过了一个极为优秀的好男人，虽然那个人对她总是淡淡的，但是如今事业上的成就完全可以弥补这个小缺点，她已经因为自己当年的不成熟，与幸福和优渥的生活擦肩而过一次，后来好不容易认识Chris，费了一番功夫终于成功成为他的心腹，她不想错失第二次机会。

轮到如斯起身报告时，她一样先报上自己的名字，才开始讲述公关部近几年的布署和成果，以及对未来的展望和规划。

Chris原本低头听着，听到中段时突然抬头看她，接着目光紧紧黏在她身上，脸上惯常的浅笑有一瞬间僵凝住。

他的异常反应很细微，只有少数几人注意到。

这场会议仅进行了一个小时便散会了，不过结束前Chris给每个人至少一项功课，指示明天同一时间开会，他要看见大家抛出新想法。

散会后，Chris第一个离开会议室，也将「压力山大」一并带走。

众人宛如被原子弹炮轰过的残骸，拖着脚步回到自己的座位，还没来得及喘口气，如斯就接到来自「上面」的电话，指示她上楼一趟。

如斯走楼梯上去时忍不住猜想着，是不是自己刚才哪里报告得不好，老板才会单独召见她，好训她一顿？唉，看来她得小心应付才行。

第2章(1)

如斯一踏上很少上来的十九楼，发觉装潢从原本的奢华感变得简约典雅，这是什么时候改变的？

回想以前上来时，她总会感到一股莫名的压迫感，好像摆设得太满了，现在改成骆驼色的地毯，一旁墙面从挂着十几幅画，变成只挂一幅古画，感觉清爽多了，心绪也不由得跟着沉淀下来。

她还没从空间变得更有质感的观察中回过神，已经被秘书高效率地请进老板办公室，她发现办公室内部也做了不少更动，变得更加简单，底蕴却更深。

「请坐。」Chris坐在大位上，脸上依旧挂着浅笑。

「谢谢老板。」如斯在他面前的座位坐下。

「喝什么？」

她愣了愣，很快反应过来，回道：「都可以。」

她从有机会踏进这个空间以来，第一次有人问她要喝什么，不会是被裁员前的最后一杯茶吧？

「都可以是咖啡还是茶呢？」这次脸上笑意漫进Chris的双眼里，一股从容不迫的自信魅力缓缓涌向她。

如斯坐在椅子上，看着他无远弗届的魅力辐射向自己，身为女性的她，深刻感受到他身为成功男士的魅力，和高颜值对自己产生的吸引力，但身为员工的她，此刻只感觉无比诡异。

老板找她上来却不急着谈公事，反倒像是要跟她一起喝下午茶，他到底想干么？根据古装剧规则来推断，皇帝杀人前都会转动手上的佛珠，所以她要被杀头了？

「老板，你找我上来不是单纯为了喝东西吧？」如斯看见他的神情微微一愣，随后又笑得一脸神秘，心里更觉得古怪了。「其实你可以直说，我心脏不错，直来直往比较不会浪费你宝贵的时间。」

Chris淡淡笑着，没对她说什么，拿起电话吩咐秘书送两杯热奶茶进来。

如斯看得一头雾水，却很聪明的适时闭上嘴，静静看着他优雅自信地安排着。

「我记得你以前很爱喝奶茶，不晓得这个喜好有没有变？」Chris知道她在观察自己，锐利视线穿透镜片直射向她。

「你怎么知道我以前爱喝奶茶？」她完全愣住。

他不答反问，「以前爱喝，现在呢？」

「自从被一个王八蛋背叛后，我就不喝奶茶了。」如斯不知道话题怎么会扯到奶茶上，聊到奶茶，她就想起那段不愉快的往事。

其实那件事已经过了很久，对方的长相她也记不太清楚了，但事情经过和造成的伤痕依旧清晰地刻在她心底。

「是吗？」Chris苦涩一笑。

「老板，你找我到底……」如斯直视着他，希望他可以直接说重点。

叩、叩。

秘书敲了两下门，得到指示后进门，手中的托盘上头放着两杯热奶茶，一杯给老板，一杯给如斯，临离开前，还别有深意地看了如斯一眼。

如斯微微皱起眉，美丽的秘书小姐那是什么眼神？好像有点惊讶，又有点困惑，除此之外还有浓浓的防备和嫉妒……这是为什么啊？

「如斯，请用。」Chris朝她做了个请的手势。
content_en:
Everyone was silent immediately, and more than fifty pairs of eyes looked towards the door.

A tall man in a neat suit stepped into the conference room. He wore a pair of rimless glasses on his handsome face, which made him look more elegant and reserved. He stood in front of the stage with confident steps and slowly scanned everyone present.

He was accompanied by a bodyguard and two secretaries, who stood respectfully behind him as he sat down.

"Hi everyone, I'm Chris."

When Chris glanced at Jiang Tingyue, she smiled sweetly at him. He only nodded slightly and continued to glance down.

But this glance gave everyone unlimited imagination - Jiang Tingyue really knew the new boss.

Chris looked all the way down. When his eyes fell on such a face, his expression was slightly startled, looking a little confused and thinking about something. After two seconds, his eyes continued to move downwards.

So he didn't miss the hesitation in his eyes.

Why does the new boss look at her like that?She looked at Chris, and an indescribable sense of familiarity washed over her like a tidal wave.

who is he?

Chris first said something to stabilize the morale of the army, asking everyone to work hard, and also introduced a coveted bonus system. No matter who sells the artwork handled by the company, they will receive an additional 5% commission, including all partners of the gallery.

Then came the highlight. Chris began to ask the heads of each department one by one about their work profile.

On the surface, it seemed that he was listening carefully to the reports of each supervisor, but in fact, he already knew the company's operations. The reason why he asked was just to weigh everyone's ability and weight.

Although Jiang Tingyue had just joined the company not long ago, her report was clear and fluent. Finally, she also proposed to rate all head office employees every six months. Those who scored in the bottom third must resign, so that the company can continuously eliminate the bad and retain the best, leaving outstanding employees.

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was stunned on the spot, and the atmosphere suddenly became extremely awkward. Everyone looked at each other, and no one responded.

Chris just smiled lightly and said nothing, deliberately making the scene tense.

After a while, Xiaohui was the first to jump out and said, "I object. This is disguised annual layoffs."

Ajie immediately expressed his support, "I am also opposed to it. Doing so will turn colleagues into competitors."

"To a certain extent, colleagues are the best competitors." Jiang Tingyue said expressionlessly, "Not only will employees be eliminated, but bosses will also be eliminated, like the former boss of this company."

As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere became even more condensed.

"The former boss gave Jiang Tingyue a cold look because of the floods a while ago, and then automatically silenced his next words.

Chris was noncommittal about the proposal and asked the next supervisor to report with a smile.

Chris's reaction made Jiang Tingyue sink her face in displeasure.

It was not her first day working in society, and she knew very well how annoying it was for her to raise this issue, but in order to please Chris, gain his approval, and at the same time show her wholehearted support for him, she did so.

She wanted to be more than just an excellent employee, she wanted to be able to stand by his side forever.

When she was in college, she missed out on an extremely good man because she was young and loved to play. Although that man always treated her indifferently, her career achievements now can completely make up for this small shortcoming. She had already missed a happy and privileged life once because of her immaturity back then. Later, she finally met Chris and after a lot of effort, she finally succeeded in becoming his confidant. She didn't want to miss the second chance.

When it was her turn to stand up and report like this, she always reported her name first, and then began to talk about the deployment and achievements of the public relations department in recent years, as well as her prospects and plans for the future.

Chris originally lowered his head to listen, but suddenly looked up at her in the middle of the sentence, and then his eyes were glued to her, and the usual smile on his face froze for a moment.

His abnormal reactions were subtle and only a few people noticed.

The meeting broke up after only an hour, but before the end, Chris gave everyone at least one assignment, instructing the meeting to be held at the same time tomorrow, and he wanted to see everyone come up with new ideas.

After the meeting, Chris was the first to leave the conference room, taking the "stressful" person with him.

Everyone was like the wreckage of an atomic bomb, dragging their feet back to their seats. Before they could take a breath, they received a call from "above" instructing her to go upstairs.

As she walked up the stairs like this, she couldn't help but wonder, was it because her boss had summoned her alone to give her a lesson because she had reported something poorly just now?Alas, it seems she will have to be careful.

Chapter 2(1)

As soon as I set foot on the 19th floor, which I seldom go up to, I found that the decoration changed from the original luxury to simple and elegant. When did this change?

Recalling that when she came up, she always felt an inexplicable sense of oppression, as if the furnishings were too full. Now it has been changed to a camel-colored carpet, and the wall hanging on one side has changed from more than a dozen paintings to only one ancient painting. She feels much more refreshed, and her mind can't help but settle down.

Before she could recover from the observation that the space had become more textured, she had already been efficiently invited into her boss's office by the secretary. She found that many changes had been made inside the office, making it simpler but with a deeper foundation.

"Please take a seat." Chris sat on the big seat, still with a slight smile on his face.

"Thank you, boss." She sat down in the seat in front of him.

"What to drink?"

She was stunned for a moment, then quickly came to her senses and replied, "Anything is fine."

For the first time since she had the opportunity to step into this space, someone asked her what she wanted to drink. Wouldn't it be the last cup of tea before she was laid off?

"Can it be coffee or tea?" This time, a smile spread into Chris's eyes, and a calm and confident charm slowly came to her.

Sitting on the chair like this, watching his far-reaching charm radiating towards her, as a woman, she deeply felt his charm as a successful man and the attraction of his good looks to her, but as an employee, she only felt extremely weird at the moment.

The boss came to her, but he was not in a hurry to talk about business. Instead, he seemed to want to have afternoon tea with her. What did he want to do?According to the rules of costume dramas, the emperor would turn the beads on his hand before killing people, so she was going to be beheaded?

"Boss, you didn't come to me just for a drink, did you?" Ru Su was slightly startled when she saw his expression, and then smiled mysteriously, which made her feel even weirder."Actually, you can just tell me that I have a good heart. It will not waste your precious time if you tell me directly."

Chris smiled lightly and didn't say anything to her. He picked up the phone and asked his secretary to bring in two cups of hot milk tea.

He was so confused, but he wisely closed his mouth at the right time, and quietly watched him arrange it gracefully and confidently.

"I remember that you used to love drinking milk tea. I wonder if this preference has changed?" Chris knew that she was observing him, and his sharp gaze penetrated the lenses and stared straight at her.

"How did you know that I used to drink milk tea?" She was completely stunned.

He didn't answer but asked, "I used to like drinking, but what about now?"

"Ever since I was betrayed by a bastard, I stopped drinking milk tea." She didn't know how the topic came to be about milk tea. When talking about milk tea, she remembered that unpleasant past.

In fact, it had been a long time since that incident, and she couldn't remember the other person's appearance clearly, but the incident and the scars caused were still clearly engraved in her heart.

"Really?" Chris smiled bitterly.

"Boss, are you looking for me to the end..." Rusu looked directly at him, hoping that he could get to the point directly.

Knock, knock.

The secretary knocked on the door twice and walked in after receiving instructions. There were two cups of hot milk tea on the tray in his hand, one for the boss and one for this. Before leaving, he gave this a meaningful look.

She frowned slightly, what was that look in the beautiful secretary's eyes?He seems a little surprised, a little confused, and in addition, there is a strong sense of defensiveness and jealousy... Why is this?

"That's it, please use it." Chris made a gesture of invitation towards her.
